snippet.title: Ultimate Hunting - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Ultimate Hunting is a new Unreal Engine 5-powered hunting sim due out in 2025 that's got both single-player and 16-player multiplayer modes. You'll hunt in two real-life locations: the California Hunting Reserve and the Southern Africa Hunting Reserve. Ultimate Hunting features a Random Antler Generation System (RAGS), dynamic need zones, and active camouflage and promises to "promote the principles of ethical behavior of hunters." Learn more and wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376880/Ultimate_Hunting
